tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Long geodesics are asymptotic to rays] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0480 ↗ def:chow-iii-i1-rays-busemann 1. appi:1.4\group Busemann geometry

If $\theta (r)$ is the supremal angle at $p$ between an arbitrary minimizing segment of length at least $r$ and the closest ray from $p$, then $\lim _{r\to \infty }\theta (r)=0$.
